mapping_json.fidelity_notes: MINE-DELIVERED CASCADE. Geometry: dossier is explicit -- '4 cascading overlapping circular areas in sequence (forward march)', 'series of small bursts... knocking them back in the direction of the next burst'. The dominant footprint is a FORWARD-MARCHING LANE of eruptions -> line (a sequenced-along-an-axis AoE), noted over ground_targeted_circle (single patch) and ground_slam (single quake) because the marching-sequence IS the identity. water/cold; ailments chill+freeze (native shatter) + knockback (each burst shoves toward the next -- a load-bearing signature). Mine delivery -> trigger_grammar on-cast-linked/linked-cast (mine-throw links the GC cast, detonate fires) + activation-toggle for the throw/detonate rhythm; DEPTH-1 (throw links, detonate fires) within MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH. GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade is the exact door -- the 4-burst forward-march IS a geometry propagation. The 'overlap circles on a single target for multi-hit' (AoE-passives widen radius, not range) is a numeric AoE-scaling property noted in traits.
